_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH ONLY - the Claude Code CLI does not read this file. A bare project-level .claude/hooks/hooks.json is a hook source for *plugins*, not for projects. The CLI reads hooks from .claude/settings.json (tracked), .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored), ~/.claude/settings.json, managed policy, plugin hooks/hooks.json, and skill/agent frontmatter. Edit this file, then run tools/sync-hooks-to-settings.sh to merge the .hooks key below into .claude/settings.json - that is the file that actually executes.
_comment_paths: Commands resolve through ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.} so hooks fire correctly regardless of the shell's cwd. Bare relative paths break the moment Claude Code runs a tool from a subdirectory.
_comment_sessionstart: Prints the SpecRoute skeleton status banner (built vs TODO dirs, agent count, sanitization warning). Informational; always exits 0. Not async - the stdout is injected as session context, and an async hook's output arrives too late to be context.
_comment_pretooluse: The sanitization gate. Blocks git commit / git push / gh pr create / gh release create when a term from the gitignored .claude/.forbidden-strings.txt appears in a tracked file. Deliberately NOT narrowed with a per-hook "if" condition: this is a publish gate, and a narrowing pattern that fails to match is a silent hole. The script's own case statement exits 0 immediately for non-publish commands, so the cost of the wide matcher is one short-lived subprocess.
_comment_posttooluse: Warn-only frontmatter lint. The script filters by path itself (agents / skills / commands), so the matcher stays at the tool level.
